purpose: Broad creative app studio coverage across user tasks, product purposes, visual directions, motion and behaviour. Cases are examples, not limits on what users can ask or claims that unrun cases passed.
transport: Codex subscription subagents; paid/external model APIs disabled.
acceptance: Each run archives exact sources, reference roles, readable current/baseline pixels, named journey results and independent review. Structural/unit checks do not establish visual quality.

cases.title: Create and compare original apps
cases.prompt: Create a polished mobile workshop-booking app called Gather with Discover, Saved and Bookings, mock event details and a reversible seat reservation. Then keep it intact and create a visually distinct alternative beside it using the same brand colours, event content and working flows.
requiredEvidence: Two independently interactive prototypes exist side by side; source baseline remains unchanged.
Search/save/detail/reserve/cancel show coherent mock states.
Variants differ meaningfully in hierarchy, navigation or component treatment; all requested constraints remain.
cases.notes: Two independent Luna-high-authored Gather variants; original18-step, alternative19-step journeys, scoped tab map and independent final visual reviews. Other prompt families are not certified by this result.

cases.title: Recreate an observed app
cases.prompt: Recreate the supplied mobile reference as a working frontend. Preserve visible sections, rows, labels, geometry, icon language and image framing. Invent coherent unseen destinations within that product language.
requiredEvidence: Corresponding same-state component pixels are compared at matching logical scale.
Observed native UI is faithful; unseen behavior is labelled inferred and works.

cases.title: Borrow one useful pattern
cases.prompt: Use the grouping pattern in inspiration A for my settings page. Keep my app colours, typography, icons, copy and routes.
requiredEvidence: Only the requested grouping changes; unrelated source-brand styling does not leak.
New settings controls and saved values work.

cases.title: Combine several inspirations
cases.prompt: Combine A’s navigation pattern, B’s media cards and C’s transition treatment into my app. Keep my brand and content. Make a coherent working design rather than three pasted fragments.
requiredEvidence: Reference contributions are explicit and scoped.
Whole experience is coherent, readable and functional; requested motion has elapsed/reduced-motion evidence.

cases.title: Reimagine the entire frontend
cases.prompt: Keep the user purpose and core booking journey but reimagine the whole visual identity and information architecture. Show it as a separate alternative.
requiredEvidence: Original remains unchanged; authorized departures are assessed against the new brief.
The retained core journey works in the new structure.

cases.title: Extend a product beyond its screenshots
cases.prompt: Add a calendar, notification centre and empty/error states to this app using its component language. Only the supplied home is observed.
requiredEvidence: New views do not mechanically copy source-home sections.
Relevant triggers reach inferred views; empty/loading/error/retry states have coherent mock behavior.

cases.title: Shape the app directly
cases.prompt: Change selected copy and colours, remove a section, add a sibling section, then move it above the selected section. Preserve unrelated design and data.
requiredEvidence: Actual selected native nodes change in place; no floating duplicates.
Ordering, return flows and retained user state remain valid.

cases.title: Place and reframe assets
cases.prompt: Drop the supplied image into the selected hero, replace an avatar and adjust its focal point. Keep UI badges and controls separate from the image.
requiredEvidence: Original-pixel crop evidence and intended render framing are retained.
Direct placement reaches the selected target; responsive/media cases needing source edits are explicit.

cases.title: Connect a complete frontend journey
cases.prompt: Browse, filter, open detail, reserve, see the booking, edit it and cancel. Saved items and counts should agree across views.
requiredEvidence: Observable end states and repeated actions are asserted, not only clicked.
Within one prototype, views use one coherent mock state.

cases.title: Preserve people’s work while refining
cases.prompt: After I save data and navigate to another view, refine its layout and add a component without resetting my current state, fields or scroll.
requiredEvidence: Actual mounted CSS and structural revisions preserve declared state.
Intentional dataset reset is a separate explicit operation.

cases.title: Adapt across devices
cases.prompt: Make this app work on narrow phones and wide desktop screens. Adapt navigation and layout rather than shrinking a desktop layout into a phone.
requiredEvidence: Actual renders at mobile, intermediate and desktop widths retain usable content and controls.
Overflow, component order and fixed/sticky clearance are measured at each size.

cases.title: Use motion and media as app material
cases.prompt: Add a GIF placeholder for a video section, playable video and a useful animated state transition without obscuring controls. Preserve media framing, loading/fallback states and respect reduced motion.
requiredEvidence: Actual elapsed frames, interruption/reversal and reduced-motion end states are checked.
Video loads/plays; a poster or static screenshot does not prove playback.
GIF changes in actual visible rendered pixels; native video playback time advances. Asset existence and a poster alone are insufficient.

cases.title: Prototype interactive games
cases.prompt: Create a small drag-to-sort game with keyboard controls, score, restart and pause. Keep the game interactive on the canvas.
requiredEvidence: Native pointer drag and keyboard input are checked separately; click-only private journeys cannot certify them.
Score/restart/pause states and visible feedback work.

cases.title: Work with many materials on one canvas
cases.prompt: Place app references, flow rails, two working app alternatives and image/video assets together. Rearrange them so I can compare and refine my idea.
requiredEvidence: Materials remain individually selectable and useful; original references remain preserved.
Rearranging alternatives preserves mounted runtime state and leaves unrelated work unchanged.

cases.title: Recover and keep iterating
cases.prompt: Stop a generation, keep the last valid prototype, resume a local refinement, then undo/restore the prior version.
requiredEvidence: Interrupted drafts and reviewed completions remain distinguishable.
Last valid source/assets are recoverable; retries do not duplicate edits.

cases.title: Playful learning
cases.prompt: A friendly learning app with its own cute native character, tactile raised buttons, an expressive lesson path and short practice sessions. Use the motivating clarity of playful language-learning apps as inspiration while creating an original identity. Correct and incorrect answers change the character expression, feedback and shared lesson progress; completion animates a restrained celebration.
requiredEvidence: Archive exact current source, product direction, readable default/changed-state pixels and an independent quality review.
Verify the named user flows and shared mock state, rapid/reversed actions where relevant, phone containment and actual scroll/end clearance.
For motion capture actual trigger/intermediate/end or continuous elapsed frames and a working reduced-motion state; static screenshots cannot prove motion.
Compare design decisions with this product brief and any scoped references; colour swaps alone do not establish the requested new direction.
